item.title: Bitfarms Sells $30M Bitcoin Mining Site, Exits Latin America
item.description: Bitfarms has announced a full exit from Latin America after agreeing to sell its 70 MW Paso Pe Bitcoin mining site in Paraguay. This move completes the company’s strategic pivot toward becoming a 100% North American digital infrastructure operator and energy provider, with a greater focus on high-performance computing (HPC) and AI workloads.Visit Website
